data.title: bn-1ra4: Build SQL v0.2 conformance and compatibility kit

data.body: BLOCKING — The bone acceptance requires proving that SQL 0.1 and 0.2 can be installed, locked, stubbed, and required independently. This check only builds, validates, inspects, packs, and revalidates; README lines 34-40 explicitly say it does not install or create a project lock. Consequently it can remain green if cache/lock resolution aliases the nominal versions, generated stubs are selected incorrectly, or require("wasm.NAME") cannot exercise one version. Add an executable provenance-safe integration fixture that covers the promised install/lock/stub/require boundary, or narrow the acceptance before merge.

BLOCKING — The Lua projection golden constructs the expected table itself instead of lifting the v0.2 fixture component through Sigil. In particular conformance/sql-0.2.0.lua represents u64::MAX with descriptive value_kind/decimal fields and no actual value userdata, and represents command affected-rows as a string. This test therefore cannot detect a broken sigil.u64, NULL, bytes, command, or resource-method projection. Exercise the component through the real host bridge (or a host-level component invocation harness) and compare the actual Lua values/stub generated from reflection.

BLOCKING — These malformed-input vectors are declarative only. The Rust test merely checks that limit entries say partial_result=false, and the fixture exports only internally consistent fixed results, so unknown discriminants, invalid UTF-8, maximum/oversized lists, and malformed component values never reach a decoder or produce the asserted error class. The bone coverage explicitly requires bad discriminants/strings/list sizes. Turn these into executable boundary tests against the actual lifting/validation path.

data.reason: Three acceptance-critical gaps remain: the compatibility script never exercises independent install/lock/stub/require resolution; the Lua golden self-constructs expected shapes instead of projecting actual component results through Sigil; and malformed discriminant/UTF-8/list-size vectors are declarative rather than executable. The standalone contracts, deterministic components, and current gates are green, but they do not prove the promised runtime compatibility and boundary behavior.

data.body: Resolved at 1074af070d9251d91d9e0f640cd0fb1b19894f2a. The gate now seeds both unpublished packages through Sigil PluginStore as isolated third-party-digest-only remote acquisitions, runs the production CLI plugin lock, verifies both exact lock identities and generated stubs, regenerates stubs byte-identically, and requires/invokes wasm.sql-v01 and wasm.sql-v02 in one scenario. just sigil-check passes against rebuilt Sigil 0.33.0.

data.reason: Production install-store, lock, generated-stub, and dual require path is executable at 1074af0.

data.body: Resolved at 1074af070d9251d91d9e0f640cd0fb1b19894f2a. The hand-built shape golden was deleted. conformance/sql-compatibility.sigil.lua invokes the real v0.1/v0.2 component resources through Sigil and asserts lifted positional NULL, binary bytes, u64::MAX userdata, s64, -0, DECIMAL, temporal metadata, row sets, command u64 fields, stateful calls, and errors. The actual reflected v0.2 stub is now the checked golden.

data.reason: Real component results now traverse Sigil production Lua lifting at 1074af0.

data.body: Resolved at 1074af070d9251d91d9e0f640cd0fb1b19894f2a. Driver-representable row/metadata/list/byte/overflow vectors execute in the SDK and real scenario. Exact Sigil malicious-component tests execute malformed variant discriminants, invalid canonical strings, and exact/plus-one host allocation bounds. docs/sql-conformance-boundaries.md records that safe WIT cannot forge invalid discriminants/UTF-8 and that >u64 logical allocation is impossible below Sigil host limits, so these are canonical-ABI rejection/reference-arithmetic tests rather than fabricated SQL errors.

data.reason: All legitimately constructible invalid vectors execute; impossible canonical values and overflow are precisely documented and tested at their real boundary.
